note: Hand-curated outcomes for State Department lot files that NARA's catalogue does not resolve by control number (#375). No generator writes this file: every row is human archival judgement, so a re-harvest must never overwrite it. Rows are deliberately NOT written into central-files-index.json, volume-sources-index.json, or collection-authority.json — those bundles feed surfaces that cannot express doubt (an icon-only link, a PDF export row, a prose 'resolved offline' caption), and a non-deterministic outcome must not reach them. CuratedLotContainmentTests enforces that.

lots.creatorName: President (1945-1953 : Truman). Office of the Special Envoy to China.
lots.rationale: NARA did not accession this lot as one series. It arranged the Marshall Mission's records under the mission's own creator record, as ten series split by record type. Any of them may hold the cited document.

lots.rationale: FRUS cites the Council of Foreign Ministers records as one flat lot. NARA arranged them by conference session and document type instead — about 170 series across 1945–1954, with titles such as "Numbered Documents" and "Minutes of Meetings" recurring once per session.
lots.guidance: No mechanical lot-to-series mapping exists. Matching a citation means knowing which session and which date it belongs to. Contact the National Archives reference staff for Record Group 43 with the conference, the date, and the document number from the citation; they will identify the entry number to request.
